title: Water & Electricity Tariffs 2017
archive_note: The publisher's own PDF, downloaded directly. It is linked today from the live Understand Your Bill page as the tariff-type reference, which is how it was found.
establishes: The expatriate residential water rate as published for 2017: AED 7.84 per 1,000 litres within the daily allowance and AED 10.41 above it, with the allowance at 700 litres a day for a flat and 5,000 for a villa.
That the same 7.84 / 10.41 figures were in force before 1 January 2018, the date UAE VAT was introduced.
A fixed charge of AED 150 a month for unmetered water supply, which shows the schedule's format carries a fixed charge where one exists.
That no fixed or recurring charge is priced for metered residential water in this schedule.
The document's own dating: it is titled 2017 and its footnotes state that the rates reflect 2017 actual cost and are subject to annual change.
does_not_establish: Any statement about VAT. The booklet contains no VAT footnote at all — which is itself consistent with a document published before the tax existed.
Whether the schedule enumerates every charge a bill may carry, as distinct from every tariff. The bill guide is the document for that.
